trickyParts: A resolved ask's answer survives only in ask.answered events for rows document settlement retracted while answered (constraint 0007 forces answer null on resolved rows); attachAskStates reads them with loadAskAnswersByAsk only when a resolved ask hit is on the page, and the Go test seeds such a row as ask_answer_change_test.go does.
A changed answer sent with no selected stores selected null; attachAskStates normalises it to [] so the wire never carries null.
The browser suite reads packages/contracts/dist: rebuild it (bun run build) before every Playwright run, and after any base-restore run, or the run tests a stale contracts build.

The Go api suite's TestIssueRanksStayOrderedPastLowercaseDigitsAndProductionShapedMoves refuses to run on the pod harness's C-collation database (rank_test.go:317); that is the environment, per docs/solutions/testing/…-LEGION-752.md.
deviations: The ask state is attached in the search handler (api/search.go `search`) rather than inside runFusedSearchQuery/runMeaningSearch: the write-time suggestions share runFusedSearchQuery but never use Ask (suggestionFromResult drops it), so the plan's placement cost them extra queries and could drop a write's suggestions on a failed read. TookMS still counts the read. The plan's TestSuggestionsSearchCarriesAskStates went with it; dispatch://INFRA-568 calls attachAskStates from its own related-item check (its implementer's Envoy message, 2026-10-27T04:10Z).
attachAskStates decodes rows through docs.ScanAsk (docs.AskColumns) rather than a hand-written copy of its answer/resolution decoding.
AskResolutionLine (web/src/features/refs/AgentName.tsx) gained an optional agent="static" prop so the palette names the closer without a link inside a listbox option; existing callers are unchanged.
